#!/bin/sh
# One call of kith-room-ledger: w.sh SIDE... ENVFILE STDIN ARGS...
#   SIDE     py KERNEL | rs BIN KERNEL
#   ENVFILE  a file in e/ of KEY=VALUE lines to export, or - for none
#   STDIN    a file in in/, - for none, or par: eight runs at once, on in/p1 .. in/p8, then wait
side=$1; shift
if [ "$side" = py ]; then kernel=$1; shift; else bin=$1; kernel=$2; shift 2; fi
envf=$1; in=$2; shift 2
d=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
if [ "$envf" != - ]; then
  while IFS= read -r l; do [ -n "$l" ] && export "$l"; done < "$d/e/$envf"
fi
go() {
  if [ "$side" = py ]; then python3 "$kernel/bin/kith-room-ledger" "$@"
  else "$bin" kernel room-ledger --kernel "$kernel" "$@"; fi
}
if [ "$in" = par ]; then
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do go "$@" < "$d/in/p$i" & done
  wait
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$in" = - ]; then go "$@" < /dev/null; else go "$@" < "$d/in/$in"; fi
